parameters.text: =Pick a single lookback start_date for {{ $('Stock') }} that yields ~24 months of trailing data. Return YYYY-MM-DD.

messageValues.message: You are a SQL date planner. Produce exactly one structured field named start_date.

parameters.query:
WITH profile AS (
  SELECT symbol, "companyName", sector, industry, "marketCap", beta
  FROM demo.instrument_profile
  WHERE symbol = '{{ $('Stock') }}'
  LIMIT 1
),
income_recent AS (
  SELECT
    symbol,
    AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue,
    AVG("netIncome") AS avg_net_income,
    AVG(eps) AS avg_eps,
    MAX(date::date)::text AS latest_report
  FROM demo.financial_income_statement
  WHERE symbol = '{{ $('Stock') }}'
    AND date::date >= '{{ $('SQL Date Planner').item.start_date }}'::date
  GROUP BY symbol
)
SELECT
  p.symbol,
  p."companyName" AS company_name,
  p.sector,
  p.industry,
  p."marketCap" AS market_cap,
  p.beta,
  COALESCE(i.avg_revenue, 0) AS avg_revenue,
  COALESCE(i.avg_net_income, 0) AS avg_net_income,
  COALESCE(i.avg_eps, 0) AS avg_eps,
  i.latest_report
FROM profile p
LEFT JOIN income_recent i ON i.symbol = p.symbol;

WITH bars_recent AS (
  SELECT
    symbol,
    MAX(high) AS recent_high,
    MIN(low) AS recent_low,
    AVG(close) AS recent_close_avg,
    SUM(volume) AS total_volume,
    MAX(timestamp)::text AS latest_ts
  FROM demo.ohlc_10m
  WHERE symbol = '{{ $('Stock') }}'
    AND timestamp >= '{{ $('SQL Date Planner').item.start_date }}'::timestamp
  GROUP BY symbol
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT symbol, metric::jsonb AS m
  FROM demo.market_metrics
  WHERE symbol = '{{ $('Stock') }}'
  ORDER BY version DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  b.symbol,
  b.latest_ts,
  b.recent_high,
  b.recent_low,
  b.recent_close_avg,
  b.total_volume,
  m.m ->> '52WeekHigh'     AS week52_high,
  m.m ->> '52WeekLow'      AS week52_low,
  m.m ->> 'beta'           AS beta,
  m.m ->> 'peTTM'          AS pe_ttm,
  m.m ->> 'epsGrowthTTMYoy' AS eps_growth_ttm
FROM bars_recent b
LEFT JOIN metrics m ON m.symbol = b.symbol;

SELECT
  symbol,
  STRING_AGG(title, ' | ' ORDER BY "publishedDate" DESC) AS headlines,
  STRING_AGG(
    LEFT(COALESCE(summary, text, ''), 200),
    ' || ' ORDER BY "publishedDate" DESC
  ) AS synopses,
  COUNT(*) AS news_count
FROM (
  SELECT *
  FROM demo.news_metadata
  WHERE symbol = '{{ $('Stock') }}'
    AND id IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY "publishedDate" DESC
  LIMIT 5
) recent
GROUP BY symbol;
